locations.note: 1403: Sigismund's Cumans raze Skalitz, today's Stříbrná Skalice, and kill Henry's parents; the blacksmith's son flees with the sword his father made.
Henry rides to Talmberg to warn Sir Divish of the attack; later Tóth's mercenaries take the castle and seize Divish's wife Stephanie.
Rattay, Sir Radzig's town and Hans Capon's home, where Henry enters Radzig's service and becomes his envoy.
Sasau, the town on the Sázava with its silver-lined market, at the western end of the map.
Henry goes undercover as a novice in the Sasau monastery to find a bandit hiding among the monks.
Uzhitz, one of the real villages of the Rattay lands Henry rides through.
Ledetchko, the river village below Talmberg, is one of the real villages Henry rides through.
Merhojed, the village where Henry fights a plague in the side quest Pestilence.
Samopesh is one of the real villages of the Talmberg lands Henry rides through.

routes.name: Henry of Skalitz
routes.note: From the burning of Skalitz to the retaking of Talmberg.
